license_note: Google provides the release as a managed service of the Cloud Text-to-Speech API under the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service. The terms bar copying, reverse engineering, and redistributing the services, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service, the agreement that governs the Cloud Text-to-Speech API (restrictions in section 3.3)

access_boundary: This record represents the Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS release identified by the Cloud Text-to-Speech model ID gemini-2.5-pro-tts, generally available since September 30, 2025. The Gemini API's separate gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts preview code, the Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite TTS preview, the Gemini 3.1 and Gemini 3.8 TTS releases, and the Chirp voices remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents the model ID, text-in and audio-out data types, token limits, and speaker support on its Cloud Text-to-Speech page
The Cloud Text-to-Speech release notes date the general-availability launch and name both model IDs
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation

Google's Cloud documentation fetched for this review gives no retirement date for the model, and the Gemini API lists its own preview-tts codes for Gemini 2.5 TTS with a November 17, 2026 earliest shutdown
Cloud terms are a general customer agreement rather than a model-specific licence

evidence.label: Cloud Text-to-Speech Gemini-TTS documentation listing gemini-2.5-pro-tts with its text input, audio output, and token limits
Cloud Text-to-Speech release notes: general availability of gemini-2.5-flash-tts and gemini-2.5-pro-tts on September 30, 2025
